reader_summary.headline: If you look down at your phone.
reader_summary.overview: If you look down at your phone, there are so many objects that exist in the physical world that have been absorbed into it. Maps, calculators, mail, clocks, and of course, for many, your wallet. In today's episode, you'll get to hear from one of the people who help build Apple Pay and Apple Wallet into these crazy little pocket computers.

key_points.text: Hi, I'm Alex Rampel, a general partner at A16C, In this conversation, I talked to Jennifer Bailey.
key_points.evidence_quote: Hi, I'm Alex Rampel, a general partner at A16C, In this conversation, I talked to Jennifer Bailey, the legendary vice president of Apple Pay and Apple Wallet, whose work has revolutionized everything from digital payment to transit cards, contactless tickets, hotel and car keys, and more.

key_points.text: Since overseeing the launch of Apple Pay a decade ago, Jennifer has led its expansion into 75 markets worldwide.
key_points.evidence_quote: Since overseeing the launch of Apple Pay a decade ago, Jennifer has led its expansion into 75 markets worldwide, now encompassing over 11,000 bank and network partners.

key_points.text: In this conversation, we cover her unconventional path rising through the rings at Apple, the challenges she confronted pushing Apple pay into the mainstream.
key_points.evidence_quote: In this conversation, we cover her unconventional path rising through the rings at Apple, the challenges she confronted pushing Apple pay into the mainstream, new Apple verticals on the horizon, and her hard-earned advice for early entrepreneurs.

thesis: The episode features Jennifer Bailey, a former Apple executive, discussing her career path from early-stage internet startups like Netscape to her role in building Apple Pay and Apple Wallet. She emphasizes that success in business often depends on great timing and the ability of a team to remain flexible and adapt to changing market conditions.
